assertion_analysis.failure_condition: The persister fails to request written ids or fails to establish the provisional pending target before invoking the writer; the database query is a positive control seeing the very target whose later absence is asserted.

A refused source is returned as finalized, is not parked failed after its exhausted attempt, retains its token, or loses the concrete writer refusal; restoring batch abort or omitting mark_sources_failed fails these checks.
Restoring the orphan-retirement omission leaves a pending database row and no removal receipt; both absence and receipt assertions fail independently of test input.
Restoring unconditional deletion or removal of another source producer changes the surviving pending target or its independent producer query.
Restoring unconditional reservation deletion strands positive-spend or catalog-authorized targets without the expected producer; base graph logs demonstrate both failures.
Removing the retirement call prevents the planted post-retirement exception; committing retirement outside the parent transaction leaves a deletion receipt or source/target effects after abort.

Returning a refused name as finalized, retaining its pending placeholder or token, or losing its actual grammar diagnostic fails direct real-writer graph readbacks; restoring retirement omission fails the pending-target assertion.
